nodes.title: The whiteboard is drawn by ONE implementation: shared/whiteboard.js (normalise/lint/tokens/facts/hand-drawn geometry) + src/modules/whiteboard/Player.tsx (draw-on strokes, letter-by-letter labels, fills after outlines, erase, highlight), registered as the Studio stage's `whiteboard` renderer; timed from the spoken line's first audio sample (clock.ts markLineAudioStart / taxila:line-audio-start), starting on its own after a 1.2 s grace when no anchor comes; reduced motion shows each op complete at its startMs

Studio ladder rungs 4-5: an explain / worked-example / re-teach move with no T1 engine to show mounts the frame engine explainer@1, which draws a WhiteboardScript built by server templates (6 maths: fraction-parts, combine-count, number-line-hop, column-op, place-value, equal-groups; 5 diagrams: flow, cycle, compare, parts, label on a vetted sketch). Order: maths code pick from the move's own text -> the topic library -> the lesson's live model fill -> nothing. Diagrams are drawn on the whiteboard player, NOT on scene@1 as BUILD-PLAN W2-B #3 words it

server/forge/explainer/library.json: one diagram template call per c4-c7 topic with no maths code pick, filled offline by taxila-fast (strict schema) and accepted only if every label word and number is the kit's own (truth.js) and it expands, lays out and lints; re-checked against the current kit at load (a kit edit retires a stale entry); a topic with no entry gets a live fill at lesson start / the hook move (background quota lane)

The teacher sees the screen: modules.js moduleFacts(s.module) -> StudioFacts {kind, archetype, onScreen} (the shape Studio's facts share), written as ONE telegraphic content row ('on screen now (values; ...): engine · name value · ...') into the move's content after planModule, for both lanes; a bound plan's key never appears; the row goes when the module goes. The show-move module's values come from the same text as her content (worked example when her content is the worked example, else the item)

modules.js screenContradiction(text, module): the reply names part counts (fraction denominators, part words incl. Hinglish, 'N equal parts / N barabar hisse') the mounted module does not show -> a rewrite reason with the facts row. Wiring into routes/lesson.js textReply's problems list is W2-E's hot file: patch at server/forge/seam-patches/w2b-screen-guard.patch

Forge skins gain football, drawing, stories, building, nature (HOOKS rows en/hi/hi_latn, decor sprites from the scene@1 library, keyword rules), so all 12 onboarding tiles map to a skin; shared/forge.ts InterestId widened. The shared interest registry stays W2-C's

Loading the lesson screen (WorkTray's chunk) schedules, on idle, a hidden sandboxed modules.html#warm:<engines> frame that loads the frame runtime and the explain rungs' engine chunks (explainer, scene and 6 maths engines) and is removed; bootstrap.tsx's warm mode never announces ready

Strict render-check (evals/forge-explainer.mjs; all checks per script: strict normalise, inside the board, no overlapping text, facts present, band duration cap, drawn tokens trace to the call, kit truth for library entries): 100% per template on the parameter sweep (fraction-parts n=264, combine-count 187, number-line-hop 48, column-op 400, place-value 8, equal-groups 40, flow 5, cycle 4, compare 4, parts 5, label 4) and on every c4-c7 real code pick / library entry (fraction-parts 138, combine-count 174, number-line-hop 13, column-op 190, place-value 38, equal-groups 34, flow 209, cycle 11, compare 99, parts 12); offline, code-only, 2026-10-04

Through the real Director (step(), no_evidence child, 8 turns), c4-c7 explain moves with something on the tray: 383/394 (engine 97, board 286, none 11); by subject maths 140/142, science 69/69, evs 39/40, sst 33/34, english 48/53, hindi 54/56. Before W2-B: 97/394 (engines only). Studio is not live yet, so this IS the Studio-off case. Offline, 2026-10-04

Library build: 331 of 345 c4-c7 topics without a maths code pick got an accepted fill (taxila-fast, effort none, strict schema; up to 2 feedback retries); per call p50 1.24-1.95 s, p95 1.45-1.96 s across passes (US sandbox -> eastus2); first pass 260/345 before the label rules were tuned; rejects were Hindi inflections not in the kit vocabulary, labels over 32 chars, kit-absent words

evals/forge-teacher-screen.mjs, n=40 explain/worked-example turns on c4-c7 maths topics (fraction topics first), real compile() + taxila-fast reply, text lane: part counts she says match the screen in 30/40 (75%) WITHOUT the facts row, 35/40 (87.5%) with it, 39/40 (97.5%) with the facts row + the screenContradiction rewrite; the one guard-arm miss names 5/4 over a flow board that shows no part counts. Strict all-numbers diagnostic: 26/40 -> 30/40 -> 33/40

evals/engines-prewarm.mjs, dist served by serve.mjs on localhost (no network RTT), Chromium, first explainer@1 mount (iframe inserted -> board painted), n=10 per arm: 1x CPU cold p50 119 / p90 144 ms, warm p50 100 / p90 115 ms; 4x CPU cold p50 684 / p90 813 ms, warm p50 344 / p90 427 ms, second mount in the same page p50 387 ms. The warm first mount is <= 150 ms at 1x only
Azure Content Safety over every strings-table row after the five new skins (evals/forge-g1.mjs --safety-only): 122 unique rows, max severity 0, 0 flagged, 0 errors

Tried: the fill schema capped labels at maxLength 24 (the board's text cap). Broke: the model cut words to fit ('Fewer flowers get polli', 'Less mustard oil and'): 23 truncated + 30 punctuation rejects of 345 on the first build. Now: schema 40, the code check enforces <= 32 (two lines of <= 24) and refuses dangling function words

Tried: warming the browser caches (a hidden warm frame) to reach a <= 150 ms first mount. Broke at 4x CPU: warm p50 344 ms and even a second mount in the same page p50 387 ms, because a new sandboxed document re-boots React each time; caches only halve the cold 684 ms. <= 150 ms at 4x needs a pre-booted frame kept in place (no reparenting), open item w2b-preboot-frame

Tried: the facts row alone to keep her part counts on the screen's. Broke: 35/40, not 100%: on explain moves she still teaches with her own example fractions (1/4 vs 1/8 over a 2/5 2/3 board) and once announced 'Whiteboard: 1/8 < 1/4'. The rewrite predicate (screenContradiction) takes it to 39/40

W2-B local acceptance (serve.mjs + dist, Neon test branch): w2b-explain-rungs 34/34 (rung on the explain move 11/12: board 8, engine 3); w2b-first-paint 17/17, rung fills the tray on every explain move, explain response -> painted p50 443 / p90 466 ms from the sandbox (the 300 ms gate is the probe fleet's); w2seam-contracts 11/11
